name: Crunchbase
summary: Company, funding, investor and people data from the Crunchbase REST API (v4): entity lookup, search and autocomplete.

api_key.description: your Crunchbase API key (Crunchbase API integrations page > Show Key); API access comes through the Crunchbase sales team

notes: Read-only API. Limits per key: 200 requests per minute and 3 requests in flight at once; 429 may carry Retry-After.
Your key only returns the fields and collections of your licensed package.
Search pages with after_id (the last result uuid); entity cards hold at most 100 items, then page with organization.card.

endpoints.name: Look up an organization
endpoints.summary: An organization with chosen fields and relationship cards.

entity_id.description: Organization UUID or permalink (the last part of its crunchbase.com URL).

field_ids.description: Comma-separated fields to return in properties.

card_ids.description: Comma-separated relationship cards to include (each returns at most 100 items).

notes: Every field and card is optional in the response; fields you are not licensed for are not returned.

endpoints.name: Look up a person
endpoints.summary: A person with chosen fields and cards.

entity_id.description: Person UUID or permalink (the last part of its crunchbase.com URL).

field_ids.description: Comma-separated fields to return in properties.

card_ids.description: Comma-separated relationship cards to include (each returns at most 100 items).

endpoints.name: Page through one card of an organization
endpoints.summary: More than the 100 items an entity lookup embeds.

entity_id.description: Organization UUID or permalink (the last part of its crunchbase.com URL).

after_id.description: UUID of the last item of the previous page.

endpoints.name: Search organizations

query.description: Filter predicates combined with AND: {type: "predicate", field_id, operator_id, values}.

order.description: Sort instructions: {field_id, sort: asc|desc, nulls: first|last}.

limit.description: Page size, 1 to 1000 (default 100); set it explicitly.

after_id.description: UUID of the last result of the previous page, for forward paging.

notes: A read over POST: it only queries. Filters are ANDed; for OR make separate searches. Results are under entities[].properties.
Fields and operators depend on your licensed package; see the search fields and operators page.

endpoints.name: Search people

query.description: Filter predicates combined with AND: {type: "predicate", field_id, operator_id, values}.

order.description: Sort instructions: {field_id, sort: asc|desc, nulls: first|last}.

limit.description: Page size, 1 to 1000 (default 100); set it explicitly.

after_id.description: UUID of the last result of the previous page, for forward paging.

notes: A read over POST: it only queries. Same body as organization.search.

endpoints.name: Find entities by partial name
endpoints.summary: Find the UUID or permalink to use in lookups and search predicates.

collection_ids.description: Comma-separated collections, e.g. organization.companies, categories, location.cities, principal.investors.

notes: Meant for a person picking a match, not for exact entity matching.
